Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 B.N.S.S. has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the Case No.2792 of 2022 (State Vs. Akash Rathore) arising out of case crime
no.85 of 2022 under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 504, 506 Ipc, Police Station Fatehabad,
District Agra, pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate-I, Fatehabad, Agra, expeditiously within a
stipulated period.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate-I, Fatehabad, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant before this Court is the informant of this case.
Accused persons / opposite parties no.2 & 3 are not appearing before the court and coercive process has been issued against them.
Due to non-appearance of the accused persons, the matter is unnecessarily lingering on and no effective proceedings are going on.
Hence prayer for expeditious disposal of the case within a time bound manner has been made.
4. I have considered the submissions and perused the entire record.

sentences.text: The applicant has made a prayer for expeditious disposal of the aforementioned case in a time bound manner.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court in a recent judgement dated 29.2.2024 passed in the case of High Court Bar Association, Allahabad Vs State of U.P and others, (2024)6 SCC 267 has held as under :-
"Constitutional Courts, in the ordinary course, should refrain from fixing a time-bound schedule for the disposal of cases pending before any other Courts.

entities.text: High Court Bar Association, Allahabad Vs State of U.P and others, (2024)6 SCC 267
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Constitutional Courts may issue directions for the time-bound disposal of cases only in exceptional circumstances.

The issue of prioritising the disposal of cases should be best left to the decision of the concerned Courts where the cases are pending; and"
6.
Learned counsel for the applicant has not shown any exceptional circumstances to issue direction for time bound disposal of the present case at this stage.

7. In the circumstances, the court concerned is directed to make all possible efforts and to use its power attributed to it by law to procure the appearance of the accused before the Court within a period of two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for the expeditious disposal of the aforesaid case, if there is no legal impediment.
8.

It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder of the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
